abstract_title: Is Quantum Integrated Information Flow Simulation Possible in Hybrid Networks
abstract: Nearly all attempts at "quantum consciousness" fall into one of two categories: philosophical conjecture (Penrose–Hameroff ORCH-OR, wavefunction collapse theory) and ambiguous comparisons (entanglement = consciousness) and uncertainty in biology: are microtubules quantum? However, would it be possible to avoid all of these and build computational frameworks?
